rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose equivalent for something not official, whether it is unconfirmed or lacks official authority.

example.english: This is unofficial news and it has not been confirmed yet.
example.traditional: 呢個係非官方消息，仲未得到證實。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 fei1 gun1 fong1 siu1 sik1 zung6 mei6 dak1 dou3 zing3 sat6

rows.jyutping: mei6 ging1 zing3 sik1 kok3 jing6 ge3 N
rows.note: Use this when the thing has not yet been formally confirmed or established, especially for results, reports, or announcements.

example.english: Do not announce the unofficial results publicly yet.
example.traditional: 未經正式確認嘅結果，暫時唔好對外公布。
example.jyutping: mei6 ging1 zing3 sik1 kok3 jing6 ge3 git3 gwo2 zaam6 si4 m4 hou2 deoi3 ngoi6 gung1 bou3

rows.jyutping: mei6 wok6 gun1 fong1 sau6 kyun4 ge3 N
rows.note: Use this when a person or organization is acting without official authorization, rather than when information is merely unconfirmed.

example.english: An unofficial organization cannot speak on behalf of the government.
example.traditional: 未獲官方授權嘅組織唔可以代表政府發言。
example.jyutping: mei6 wok6 gun1 fong1 sau6 kyun4 ge3 zou2 zik1 m4 ho2 ji5 doi6 biu2 zing3 fu2 faat3 jin4
